name: CoinPoker
rootCause: On November 8, a hacker breached the CoinPoker’s hot wallet, resulting in the unauthorized draining of approximately $2M USD. The attack spanned across multiple blockchain networks, including BNB Chain, Ethereum, and Polygon networks. Later, it funneled through Tornado Cash to obscure the trail and to launder the funds.

descriptions.text: On November 8, a hacker breached the CoinPoker’s hot wallet, resulting in the unauthorized draining of approximately $2M USD. The attack spanned across multiple blockchain networks, including BNB Chain, Ethereum, and Polygon networks. Later, it funneled through Tornado Cash to obscure the trail and to launder the funds.

CoinPoker’s hot wallet was compromised on 8 November 2024. Public trackers put the reported loss at about $2 million, and case pages describe activity across Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Polygon, with the exact initial access vector still unknown. Compromise of the hot wallet signing authority. The available record does not identify whether the initial access vector was phishing, malware, leaked credentials, or a custodian failure.
